Six call sites in `openmrs-module-webservices.rest` invoke `ConceptService.saveDrug`. Three are production REST resource code, and they would be affected by a change in its behaviour. The other three are in `DrugController1_10Test`, which calls it directly to set up data. Both Falkon's symbol-reference lookup and a regex grep returned the same six sites.

**Production callers, best first:**
- `DrugResource1_8.save` (line 68) is the main write path for the Drug resource. It returns whatever `saveDrug` returns.
- `DrugIngredientResource1_11.save` (line 183) saves the parent drug after adding an ingredient.
- `DrugIngredientResource1_11.purge` (line 163) saves the parent drug after removing an ingredient.
- `DrugReferenceMapResource1_10.save` (line 47) saves the parent drug after attaching a reference map.

**Test callers:**
- `DrugController1_10Test` calls `conceptService.saveDrug` at lines 133 and 144, in `shouldIncludeStrengthInDefaultRepresentation` and `shouldIncludeStrengthInFullRepresentation`. These would fail if `saveDrug` changed its persistence behaviour.
